name: SPACE MARINES: VANGUARD VETERAN SQUAD WITH JUMP PACKS
description:
Vanguard Veterans are ever eager to reach the enemy lines swiftly and strike at the foe's weaknesses. They use jump packs to bound into battle on columns of flame. Whether dropping down from the open hold of a gunship passing low overhead, or leaping through hails of fire to attack the enemy head on, these masterful warriors hit the enemy lines like a thunderbolt.

Death from Above

This multipart plastic kit builds 5 elite Vanguard Veterans for your Space Marines armies in games of Warhammer 40,000. Equipped with jump packs, they are highly mobile and aggressive melee specialists. They're armed with heavy bolt pistols to spit death at mid range, and master-crafted power weapons to expertly cut down their quarry. If you're looking for a unit to disrupt the foe, take on the greatest threats in the enemy army, and slow down their advance, this flexible squad will earn its place as a vital element of your strike force.

Customise Your Wargear

One miniature can be assembled as either a standard Vanguard Veteran or a Vanguard Veteran Sergeant with a unique head and piece of masonry on his base, a relic blade, and additional purity seals. The Sergeant can replace his relic blade with a thunder hammer or power fist, and he can replace his heavy bolt pistol with a plasma pistol. 2 Vanguard Veteran miniatures can replace their heavy bolt pistols with plasma pistols. Every miniature can replace their heavy bolt pistol with a combat shield, including a unique combat shield for the Sergeant. All 5 miniatures have a choice of 2 different shin plates on one leg. This versatile kit also includes many interchangeable parts so no two units need look alike.

Interchangeable parts:
– 10 helmeted heads
– 9 bare heads
– 5 shoulder pads with Crux Terminatus
– 6 shoulder pads
– 10 belt-mounted honours and relics
– 1 tilting shield
– 5 purity seals
– 3 left arms with master-crafted power axes
– 5 left arms with master-crafted power swords
– 3 right arms with plasma pistols
– 5 right arms with heavy bolt pistols
– 5 empty pistol holsters with pouches
– 5 right arms with combat shields
– 5 sets of grenades and decorations

Contents:
– 135 plastic components
– 5 Citadel 32mm Round Bases
– 1 construction guide
– 1 Space Marine Infantry Transfer Sheet

The Space Marine Infantry Transfer Sheet features 664 high-quality waterslide transfers. These include symbols and icons for the Ultramarines, Imperial Fists, Salamanders, and Raptors, as well as unit designations, numbers, honour markings, and campaign badges to decorate your miniatures.

These miniatures require assembly and are supplied unpainted. We recommend:
– Citadel Tools: Super Fine Detail Cutters
– Warhammer Colour Plastic Glue
– Warhammer Colour paints
